sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(g.num_marc_final AS INTEGER) - CAST(g.num_marc_inicial AS INTEGER)) AS km_total_rodado FROM frota_gastoFrota g JOIN frota_frota f ON g.seq_veiculo = f.seq_veiculo WHERE g.ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(f.dsc_marca, '') NOT ILIKE '%DIVERSOS%' AND COALESCE(f.dsc_num_placa, '') NOT IN ('-1', 'NÃO INFORMADO');
